test_title: PYST 15: RRB NTPC (UG) CBT-I - GA (Held On: 13 Aug, 2025 Shift 3)
subject: general
question: Which platform provides online learning for civil servants under Mission Karmayogi in India?
solution:
The correct answer is __**iGOT Karmayogi**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Mission Karmayogi** is a capacity-building program for **civil servants in India**. It aims to improve their efficiency and skills by providing comprehensive learning opportunities.
 
• The **iGOT Karmayogi platform** is the official online learning platform developed under the initiative of Mission Karmayogi. It serves as a digital infrastructure for capacity building.
 
• This platform offers **courses, content, and training modules** tailored to the requirements of civil servants at different levels. *Hence, the correct answer is iGOT Karmayogi.*
 
• The platform provides **continuous learning opportunities** for civil servants by leveraging technology for skill enhancement, knowledge sharing, and performance improvement.
 
• It is backed by the Government of India and aims to create a **competency-driven civil service** to meet national developmental goals effectively.
 
• The initiative is designed to ensure that civil servants are equipped with the **latest knowledge and skills** required for effective governance in a rapidly changing world.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

__
 
• **iGOT Karmayogi Platform:**

 
 
• **iGOT stands for Integrated Government Online Training**. It is a **dedicated online platform** specifically built for the training and capacity building of civil servants.
 
• The platform hosts a vast repository of **learning resources**, including modules, webinars, case studies, and videos, designed to address the **specific needs of civil servants**.
 
• The focus is on creating a **competency-based training structure** to ensure that civil servants are updated with the latest knowledge for effective governance.
 
 
 
• **Mission Karmayogi:**
 
 
• Launched in **2020**, Mission Karmayogi is a national program for capacity building to reform and strengthen governance.
 
• It aims to create a **future-ready civil service** equipped with the right competencies to deliver services efficiently.
 
• The program is governed by the **Karmayogi Bharat**, a special-purpose vehicle (SPV) to provide technical support to the platform.
 
 
 
• **Comparison with Other Options:**
 
 
• **NISG Portal:** The National Institute for Smart Government (NISG) supports governance-related technology solutions but does not serve as the official learning platform under Mission Karmayogi.
 
• **ePathshala:** A digital platform by NCERT for students and teachers, focusing on academic learning rather than civil service training.
 
• **SWAYAM:** An initiative by the Ministry of Education to provide free online courses for students and professionals but is not specifically designed for civil servants.
 
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/4f750a2730aad0987b5e719f277ddc90129c657928205c4d3b5aa23049023fa5.png] **Important Points__**

 
• **Key Features of iGOT Karmayogi:**

 
 
• It provides **customized training** modules based on the specific requirements of different roles in civil services.
 
• The platform is accessible across **multiple devices**, allowing civil servants to learn anytime and anywhere.
 
• It integrates **data analytics** to track progress and effectiveness of training programs.
 
• The initiative is expected to enhance **transparency, accountability**, and efficiency in governance through well-trained civil servants.
 
 
 
• **Implementation of Mission Karmayogi:**
 
 
• Mission Karmayogi is supported by the **Department of Personnel and Training (DoPT)**, Government of India, ensuring a structured approach to civil servant training.
 
• A **dedicated SPV**, Karmayogi Bharat, has been established for managing and implementing the program effectively.
 
• The program is designed to be **inclusive**, offering learning opportunities for civil servants across various levels and departments.
